Chapter 643: Chapter 49: Xuanhuang Above (End Of This Volume, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 643: Chapter 49: Xuanhuang Above (End of this Volume, Please Subscribe)_3

The Galaxy Master, such powerful beings, although they do not possess ‘mind-reading,’ can still see through someone’s inner thoughts with ease.

To dislike her and yet marry Lin Yi would have been enough to incur the disdain of the Galaxy Master.

Therefore, even if the Xia Family eagerly wished to establish a connection with the Galaxy Master, they would ponder repeatedly over the choice of candidate, making sure to avoid any mistakes.

“Brother, Keren really likes me,” Lin Yi immediately said.

“I know,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Through their recent interaction, Lin Yuan had also sensed that Xia Keren truly had genuine feelings for Lin Yi.

...

But emotions like affection are destined not to last forever, and as Lin Yi’s brother, it was essential to give the other person some reminders and warnings.

The Xia Family must understand this as well.

…

The wedding of Lin Yi and Xia Keren took place the next day.

The venue was in the Virtual World, where numerous powers of human civilization and countless guests all flocked to attend.

Not only because one party of the wedding was the sister of the Galaxy Master, but also because the Xia Family’s power was deeply rooted and intricate; the union of the two powerful entities was bound to have a significant impact.

“The main branch of the human Xia Family marrying the sister of the Galaxy Master, one side with limitless potential, the other an influential and established power—this marriage alliance… tsk tsk…”

“How did the Xia Family get so lucky to actually establish a connection with the Galaxy Master?”

The guests at the wedding kept discussing.

With the news of the Galaxy Master in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm spreading, even a fool could see that the Galaxy Master’s future potential was at least at Tier 11.

Since time immemorial, the most talented individual of human civilization, who at Tier 8 defeated invincible Tier 8 beings as easily as slaughtering chickens, and at Tier 9 killed special Tier 9 beings just as effortlessly.

Such an extraordinary individual would inevitably receive full support for their cultivation from human civilization, and very likely have the opportunity to challenge the status of a Supreme Being in the future.

Should they successfully become a Supreme Being, wouldn’t the human Xia Family, as in-laws, ascend to the heavens in one step?

Of course, becoming a Supreme Being is not easy, but even if unable to step into Tier 12, to reach the Peak of Tier 11 was in the future.

For the Xia Family, there was no possibility of losing out.

It was precisely because of this reason that many guests at the scene felt that the Xia Family had stumbled upon a great bargain.

On the surface, it seemed that the Galaxy Master was currently at Tier 9, while the human Xia Family had an Eleventh-Rank Evolver at its seat.

But in reality, who knows how many families prefixed with ‘human’ wanted to connect with the Galaxy Master, but in the end, it was the Xia Family who took the lead.

Lin Yuan chatted with the fellow disciples of the Chikun Lineage.

“Is the teacher in seclusion, attempting to break through to Tier 9?” Lin Yuan nodded.

The Chikun Starlord, Lin Yuan’s teacher, did not attend Lin Yi’s wedding precisely because he was in closed-door cultivation.

Cultivating in seclusion at the critical breakthrough moment is especially crucial, allowing for no distractions whatsoever.

In fact, more than twenty years ago, the Chikun Starlord had already begun his seclusion. It was quite normal for an Eighth-Layer Evolver to be in seclusion for several decades or even a hundred years, let alone for a breakthrough at a great realm.

“It’s hard to say whether the teacher can smoothly step into Tier 9…” the various Peak Masters of the Chikun lineage said with a bit of concern.

The leap from Tier 8 to Tier 9 represents the transition from a single-space life to a multi-spatial life. Despite Lin Yuan’s seemingly effortless breakthrough, in actuality, accomplishing this transition is not at all simple.

If one completes the fusion of pillar rules with common rules and breaks through to Tier 9, it naturally denotes steady progression. But the Chikun Starlord’s purpose for secluding himself was to complete the last bit of Fusion Rules.

As for ultimately stepping into Tier 9, as long as all the prerequisite conditions are met, there’s actually very little risk and chance of unexpected events.

“There shouldn’t be any problem,” Lin Yuan stated.

The Chikun Starlord’s true form is that of the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, the ‘darling’ of the main universe’s space origin source, with profound insight into Space Rules. In the fusion of space rules with the fire rules, there should not be any significant bottlenecks.

…

“That is the Galaxy Master.”

“The Galaxy Master, stationed at the Milky Way Main Star, seldom shows himself.”

“Finally, we get to see the Galaxy Master in person.”

One after another, the guests were all paying attention to Lin Yuan, while the Xia Family, on the contrary, didn’t arouse much interest.

The influence of the Xia Family was significant, and the major figures of the family often appeared in public; the guests had basically seen all who were available to see.

On the other hand, the Galaxy Master had risen so quickly and was so legendary that many Evolvers wished to meet him but could not.

“This time, the performance of the Galaxy Master in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, my family’s elder ancestor said that once the Galaxy Master steps into Tier 10, within a hundred or a thousand years, he could reach Grade B Tier 10, and within five thousand years he could reach Grade A Tier 10…”

“My heavens, is he that terrifying?”

A few guests widened their eyes, they knew just how formidable a Grade B Tier 10 was, let alone Grade A Tier 10? Many Tenth-Rank Evolvers have cultivated for tens of thousands to millions of years and are still hovering at Grade D or C.

And the Galaxy Master could easily reach Grade A Tier 10?

Grade A Tier 10… even on a Large Alien Battlefield, that is an extraordinary force. Without a Tier 11 stepping forward, a powerful Grade A Tier 10 could influence the outcome of a particular local battlefield.

“I don’t even know when I’ll reach Tier 7, and you’re already discussing when the Galaxy Master will reach Grade A after stepping into Tier 10…”

“Sigh, we’re all human, but why is the Galaxy Master’s talent so much stronger than ours? Is it said that the Galaxy Master’s bloodline is quite ordinary?”

…

Many other Evolvers felt somewhat bitter. When they were as old as the Galaxy Master, they were probably still fumbling through the First and Second Layers, but the Galaxy Master was already rising like the sun at high noon.

…

At the wedding.

Lin Yuan was casually chatting.

Just at that moment.

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted ever so slightly.

He looked up in a certain direction.

Because at that moment, the Taiyang Divine Spirit in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had completely refined the Core of the Secret Realm.

Humming sounds resonated.

Inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, in front of him, the earthy yellow Core of the Secret Realm was spinning and merging into Lin Yuan’s forehead.

In an instant.

Lin Yuan’s soul began to infinitely soar, overlooking every little detail and aspect of the entire Xuanhuang Secret Realm from a higher level of perspective.

At this moment, Lin Yuan was like the creator deity of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and everything happening within the realm was under his watchful eye.

The Ninth-Rank Alien Race and human Ninth Rank Evolvers within the Secret Realm were completely unaware, but the indigenous creatures of the realm were faintly sensing something.

“Ao ao ao~~~”

“Roar roar roar~~~”

Across the three continents, countless powerful indigenous creatures were all kneeling on the ground, with expressions of utmost respect, revealing their submission.

Supreme Xuanhuang above!
